Measured: 105/200 commits lost with a concurrent poller vs 0/200 without. One test is xfail(strict=False) because of it. Production is unaffected: a file-backed DATABASE_URL gets AsyncAdaptedQueuePool, one connection per session.

CI runners have 2-4 cores; the overlap needs scarcity, not load.
